serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Freshservice, by Freshworks for Government, is the AI-powered, unified service operations platform that is fast to deploy, intuitive to use, and enables every employee to be more productive. Freshservice offers powerful governance and scale, without the operational drag of legacy platforms. This is a critical requirement for federal agencies navigating ever-changing and demanding missions.
Some highlights of the Freshservice solution include but are not limited to:
Freshservice ITSM – A comprehensive IT Service Management solution built on ITIL best practices, unifying incident, problem, change, and request management on a single platform
Freshservice ITOM – IT Operations Management with dependency mapping and signal correlation across systems, enabling proactive incident coordination before employees feel the impact
Freshservice ITAM – Continuous, agentless hybrid IT discovery, inventory, and dependency mapping delivers instant visibility into hardware, software, and services across data centers, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments, with insights to optimize infrastructure and applications
Freshservice ESM – Extends service delivery beyond IT to HR, Finance, and other business teams on a common data and workflow model
Freddy AI – Domain-specialized AI for IT service operations, powering a continually increasing portfolio of AI service workflows built on a decade of experience, workflow, and service domain context across tens of thousands of customers. By unifying agentic and assistive AI, Freddy AI enables zero-touch resolutions, proactive operations, and service intelligence to anticipate and solve problems at the source
Major Incident Management, extended with FireHydrant – An end-to-end incident management platform bringing on-call and alerting, chat-native response, and retrospectives into a single workflow, powered by AI and automation to help teams respond more effectively and resolve incidents faster
Freshservice empowers organizations to:
Deliver service, operations, and asset management from a single AI-powered platform
Resolve employee requests instantly, routing issues to the right team and context
Coordinate onboarding and access across IT, HR, and Finance for a smoother employee experience
Get ahead of major incidents by connecting signals and mapping dependencies across systems
Maintain accurate asset records through continuous, automated discovery
Deploy rapidly through no-code setup, intuitive configuration, and built-in best practices, without extensive consulting or custom development
Reduce costs and increase efficiencies with transparent pricing and built-in security, compliance, and governance controls

trustCenter.repositoryDescription:
This portal provides access to information and documentation related to Freshworks’ security, privacy, and compliance practices. Here you can review certifications, third-party attestations, compliance reports, and other materials commonly requested during vendor security and risk assessments.

Freshworks is committed to protecting customer data and maintaining transparency around our security and compliance posture. The resources available in this Trust Center are intended to support your due diligence process and help you better understand the controls and practices that underpin our services.

Documentation in this portal is reviewed periodically and updated as appropriate. If you require additional information or have questions regarding Freshworks’ security or compliance programs, please contact our security team for assistance.
